overview.title: Your hardware
checks.title: Checks
checks.subtitle: Firmware and hardware prerequisites before building the EFI.
check.opencore_smbios.title: Windows was started through OpenCore
check.opencore_smbios.detail: The system information shows OpenCore's Mac identity (Acidanthera), not this PC's, so model-specific settings (such as leaving out Reset NVRAM on ThinkPads) would be wrong. Restart and boot Windows directly from the BIOS boot menu, then scan again.
check.cpu_vendor.title: Unsupported CPU vendor
check.cpu_vendor.detail: Only Intel and AMD x86-64 CPUs are supported by macOS/OpenCore.
check.no_sse42.title: CPU without SSE4.2
check.no_avx2.title: CPU without AVX2
check.no_avx2.detail: macOS 13 Ventura and newer rely on AVX2; they need CryptexFixup and may not run at all.
check.hybrid.title: Hybrid CPU (P-cores + E-cores)
check.hybrid.detail: Alder Lake and newer need ProvideCurrentCpuInfo and, optionally, CpuTopologyRebuild.kext.
check.amd_laptop.title: AMD laptop
check.amd_laptop.detail: Radeon APU graphics have no native acceleration in macOS (NootedRed is experimental).
check.legacy_bios.title: Windows installed in Legacy/CSM mode
check.legacy_bios.detail: OpenCore works best on UEFI. Check whether your board supports UEFI and disable CSM.
check.secure_boot.title: Secure Boot enabled
check.secure_boot.detail: Disable Secure Boot in the BIOS before booting OpenCore.
check.thinkpad_nvram.title: ThinkPad: never reset NVRAM from OpenCore
check.thinkpad_nvram.detail: The Dortania guide warns that ThinkPads are known to be semi-bricked after an NVRAM reset in OpenCore. The generated EFI has no "Reset NVRAM" entry or hotkey; if you need to reset NVRAM, update the BIOS instead.
check.raid.title: Controller in RAID / Intel RST mode
check.raid.detail: {0}: switch SATA to AHCI in the BIOS (and disable VMD) — macOS cannot see disks in RAID/RST mode.
check.vmd.title: Intel VMD enabled
check.vmd.detail: Disable the VMD controller in the BIOS; macOS cannot see NVMe drives behind VMD.
check.mbr.title: System disk uses MBR
check.mbr.detail: {0}: macOS requires GPT; to dual boot on the same disk convert it with mbr2gpt.
check.intel_sst.title: Intel SST/SOF audio detected
check.intel_sst.detail: Digital microphones and DSP-based audio do not work in macOS; only an HDA codec (if present) can be enabled.
check.i2c_touchpad.title: I2C trackpad
check.i2c_touchpad.detail: Requires VoodooI2C + VoodooI2CHID and usually SSDT-GPIO.
check.scan_errors.title: Some scan steps failed

devices.subtitle: Full PnP dump with IDs and PCI/ACPI paths in OpenCore format.
devices.filter: Filter by name, ID or path

acpi.subtitle: Devices used to choose SSDTs (EC, RTC/AWAC, CPU, PLUG...) and firmware tables.
export.folder_title: Destination folder for the ACPI tables
compat.title: Compatibility
compat.subtitle: Every component checked against each macOS version. Hover a cell for details.
compat.recommended_none: No macOS version runs with graphics acceleration on this hardware.
compat.plan_subtitle: Pick the target macOS version to see the SMBIOS, kexts, SSDTs and settings the EFI will use.
compat.all_working: Every detected component works on this version.
compat.disclaimer: The compatibility database follows the Dortania guide and community reports. Entries marked as unverified need confirmation, especially for the newest macOS releases.
note.tahoe_last_intel: macOS 26 Tahoe is the last release with Intel support; later versions are Apple Silicon only.
note.cryptexfixup: No AVX2: requires CryptexFixup (and OpenCore Legacy Patcher for graphics).
note.unverified: Not confirmed yet on this macOS version.
note.hedt: HEDT platform: needs extra ACPI work (SSDT-UNC, RTC range fixes).
note.cpuid_spoof: Needs a CPUID spoof to Comet Lake and a dedicated GPU.
note.hybrid_cpu: Hybrid CPU: needs ProvideCurrentCpuInfo; the iGPU is not supported, a dedicated GPU is required.
note.no_igpu_support: The CPU can boot, but the Intel Xe iGPU has no macOS driver.
note.too_new: Too new: no confirmed support yet.
note.atom: Atom/Celeron low-power platforms are not supported.
note.amd_vanilla: AMD: requires the AMD Vanilla kernel patches.
note.amd_vanilla_new: Check that the AMD Vanilla patches support this version.
note.oclp_gpu: Native driver removed; OpenCore Legacy Patcher root patches are needed for acceleration.
note.skl_as_kbl: Spoof the iGPU as Kaby Lake.
note.uhd610: UHD 610 needs a device-id spoof and is often unstable.
note.intel_xe: Intel Xe and Arc graphics have no macOS drivers.
note.amd_apu: Radeon APU graphics only work through NootedRed (experimental).
note.amd_unsupported: This AMD GPU family has no macOS driver.
note.nvidia_webdriver: Only works on High Sierra with NVIDIA Web Drivers.
note.nvidia_modern: NVIDIA Turing and newer have no macOS drivers.
note.check_applealc: Check this codec in AppleALC's supported codec list.
note.i225: Needs a device-id spoof (or AppleIGC); add e1000=0 on Monterey and newer.
note.aquantia: May need a kernel patch or AppleVTD settings on newer versions.
note.check_manually: No rule for this device yet — check it manually.
note.wifi_swap: No macOS driver. Replace the card with a supported Intel or Broadcom one.
note.oclp_wifi: Native Wi-Fi was removed; needs OpenCore Legacy Patcher root patches.
note.atheros: Needs the legacy AirPortAtheros40 kext injected.
note.bt_unsupported: No macOS driver for this Bluetooth chip.
note.bad_nvme: Known to cause kernel panics in macOS; install on another SSD.
note.no_rule: No rule for this device yet.
plan.smbios.newer: {0} is not supported by {1}; using a newer model.
plan.smbios.fallback: No exact match; using the closest model that supports this version.
plan.kext.lilu: Patching framework required by most kexts.
plan.kext.ecenabler: Reads battery fields wider than 8 bits from the EC.
plan.kext.cryptexfixup: Allows booting Ventura and newer on CPUs without AVX2.
plan.kext.restrictevents: Hides the memory warning of the MacPro7,1 SMBIOS.
plan.kext.usbtoolbox: USB port mapping (macOS limit of 15 ports per controller).
plan.kext.utbmap: Your USB map — generated in the USB mapping step.
plan.ssdt.plug: Enables native CPU power management (CPU at {0}).
plan.ssdt.ec_none: Adds the EC device macOS expects (no EC found in your ACPI).
plan.ssdt.ec_laptop: Adds a fake 'EC' device; your real EC stays at {0}. Also adds USBX power.
plan.ssdt.ec_desktop: Disables the desktop EC at {0} and adds a fake 'EC' plus USBX power.
plan.ssdt.SSDT-PNLF: Backlight control for the internal display.
plan.ssdt.SSDT-RHUB: Resets the USB root hub (prevents early boot hangs).
plan.ssdt.SSDT-CPU-PM: CPU power management — generate it with ssdtPRgen on this machine.
plan.ssdt.SSDT-UNC: Fixes uncore bridges on HEDT platforms.
plan.ssdt.SSDT-RTC0-RANGE: Fixes the RTC range on HEDT platforms.
plan.ssdt.awac: AWAC clock detected: switches it to the legacy RTC macOS expects.
plan.ssdt.rtc0: No RTC found: adds a fake RTC device.
plan.ssdt.cpur: Required on {0} boards (CPU objects outside the scope macOS expects).
plan.ssdt.gpio: Enables GPIO interrupts for the I2C trackpad.
plan.ssdt.xosi: Makes the firmware enable I2C devices as it does for Windows.
plan.ssdt.dgpu_off: Turns off the unsupported dedicated GPU to save power.
plan.bootarg.debug: Verbose and debug output during installation (remove when done).
plan.bootarg.lilubeta: Lets kexts load on the newest macOS before they declare support.
plan.kext.forgedinvariant: Synchronizes the TSC across cores (ChefKiss guide: necessary for laptops).
plan.ssdt.xosi_amd: Makes the firmware behave as it does for Windows (ChefKiss guide: required on AMD laptops).
plan.warn.nootedred_vram: NootedRed: WhateverGreen was left out (they conflict). Set the iGPU memory (UMA frame buffer) to at least 512 MB in the BIOS, 1 GB or more for proper functionality.
plan.kext.mce: Stops AppleMCEReporter from panicking on AMD with this SMBIOS.
build.note.thinkpad_nvram: ThinkPad detected: ResetNvramEntry.efi was left out, so the picker has no "Reset NVRAM" entry. The guide warns that an NVRAM reset in OpenCore can semi-brick ThinkPads; reset NVRAM by updating the BIOS instead.
build.note.debug: OpenCore DEBUG build with file logging: each boot writes opencore-*.txt to the root of the USB drive, and kernel panics are saved there as panic-*.txt (ApplePanic). Booting is slower; switch to RELEASE once everything works (Post-Install → OpenCore debug log).
build.debug: OpenCore DEBUG build with log files (for troubleshooting the first boots)
build.debug_hint: Writes opencore-*.txt to the USB drive on every boot; kernel panics are saved as panic-*.txt. Slower to boot.
build.error.exists: {0} already exists. Choose an empty folder.
build.kext.utbmap: Create it with USBToolBox (Windows) after mapping your ports, then add it to EFI/OC/Kexts and config.plist.
build.kext.manual: Not available as a GitHub release; download it manually.
ssdt.manual.SSDT-CPU-PM: Generate it on macOS with ssdtPRgen (Sandy/Ivy Bridge power management).
ssdt.manual.SSDT-GPIO: Needs the GPIO pin of your trackpad; follow the VoodooI2C GPIO pinning guide.
ssdt.manual.SSDT-UNC: Use OpenCorePkg's prebuilt SSDT-UNC if your board needs it.
ssdt.manual.SSDT-RTC0-RANGE: Use OpenCorePkg's SSDT-RTC0-RANGE after checking the RTC ranges in your DSDT.
ssdt.manual.SSDT-PLUG: No CPU object was found in ACPI; create SSDT-PLUG manually.
ssdt.manual.SSDT-RHUB: No USB controller ACPI path was found; create SSDT-RHUB manually.
ssdt.manual.SSDT-dGPU-Off: The dGPU has no ACPI path; disable it in the BIOS or create SSDT-dGPU-Off manually.
build.title: Build EFI
build.subtitle: Downloads OpenCore and the kexts, generates the SSDTs and config.plist for the version selected in Compatibility, then validates everything with ocvalidate.
build.target_hint: Change the version in the Compatibility tab (EFI plan).
build.audio.title: Audio layout-id {0}
build.audio.detail: If there is no sound, try these with the alcid=N boot-arg: {0}
build.done: EFI ready at {0}. Copy the EFI folder to the EFI partition of a FAT32 USB drive.
usb.title: USB Mapping
usb.subtitle: macOS only uses 15 ports per controller. Start discovery and plug a USB 2 and a USB 3 device into every port you use; the ports light up and are selected automatically.
usb.install: Add map to the built EFI
usb.no_efi: Build the EFI first (Build EFI tab).
usb.over_limit: {0} of {1} ports selected — macOS ignores ports beyond {1}
usb.hint: Internal devices (Bluetooth, webcam, fingerprint reader) must stay selected with the Internal connector type.
usb.confirm_reset: Forget every discovered port and start the USB map again?
installer.title: USB INSTALLER
installer.subtitle: Copies this EFI (and optionally the macOS recovery) to a USB drive. Boot the target PC from it to install macOS.
installer.recovery: Download the macOS recovery from Apple (about 1 GB, verified with Apple's signature)
installer.format: Erase and format the drive as FAT32 (all data on it will be lost)
installer.no_disks: No USB drive found. Plug one in and click Refresh.
installer.confirm_overwrite: {0} already has an EFI folder. Replace it?
installer.needs_fat32: This drive has no FAT32 volume. Enable the format option.
installer.done: USB installer ready at {0}. Boot the target PC from it and choose the macOS recovery in OpenCore.
installer.no_board: OpenCore has no recovery entry for {0}.
